# Rule 0 - Admins have final say:
[color=red]If admins believe that you are an overall negative impact to the community or rounds, you will be removed/banned.[/color]
No ruleset is perfect, or ready to handle every outcome of a long duration improv game. These rules should be followed to the spirit, just as much as the letter, and admins are in game with the purpose of mediating and enforcing these rules:
\n
- Admins are able to make the final interpretation of a rule during a round.
- Even if you disagree with how an admin interprets a rule, you must still follow the interpretation they provide for you.
- Admin actions and interpretations of rules can be contested through a ticket in the discord community.
